entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • System.Web.HttpRuntime initialization enumerates every named pipe on the machine: Windows PowerShell 5.1 JSON cmdlets take seconds to minutes once .NET 11 processes hold many pipes #137522
  • [API Proposal]: Lazy subcommand registration and lookup on System.CommandLine.Command #137521
  • [wasi] Disposing a TCP socket with an in-flight send blocks the guest (wasmtime waits on output-stream drop) #137519
    12.0.0
  • [API Proposal]: Expose the type stored in a System.Reflection.Pointer #137512
  • .NET 11 regression on Windows: redirected Process.StandardOutput/StandardError leak one named pipe handle each after an async read unless the reader is disposed #137501
    12.0.0
  • [wasm][AOT] mono-aot-cross segfaults on EqualityComparer<Id<Self>> where Self is a struct holding Id<Self> (record struct typed ids) #137500
  • .NET 11 thread pool: workers spin full budget after spurious wake-ups, +40-85 % CPU per request vs .NET 10 for request/response socket workloads #137494
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: SOS_osx-arm64_Release-Bin-Net12.WorkItemExecution (missing .NET 11) #137493
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: Wasm.Build.Tests.PInvokeTableGeneratorTests.UnusedCoreLibEntryPointsAreTrimmed #137492
  • libclrjit crashes on thread exit in hosts that replace global operator new (.NET 11 regression) #137487
    12.0.0
  • [mono][wasm][AOT] llvm-only: a reference passed as an argument is kept on no shadow-stack slot, so a minor GC moves the object and the callee continues with a stale `this` #137486
  • src/tests/JIT/Directed/tls/TlsFieldLibrary tests do not run #137482
  • Managed ilasm emits duplicate MemberRef rows #137481
  • Managed ilasm emits unreadable DeclSecurity blobs #137480
  • [browser] AOT with WasmEnableExceptionHandling=false crashes clang (Emscripten 6.0.2) #137478
  • [browser] .NET 11 requires exnref exception handling: Safari < 18.4, Chrome < 137, Firefox < 131 can't run any app #137477
  • Native AOT runtime-async continuation dispatch allocates thread-static storage on first completion per thread #137474

Closed

  • ZipArchive should report better error message for empty or invalid stream #136215
    12.0.0
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: OpenSslErrorTests.GetSslLibraryReason_UsesLayoutOfLoadedOpenSsl on tvOS #136952

    12.0.0
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: ImportParameters_MismatchedKeyPair_Throws on Windows 10 1607 / Server 2016 #137469
  • Native AOT: a static profile (MibcFile) makes ILC miscompile a foreach over IEnumerable<int> passed an int[] #137063
